Interface LocalVariableInfo

public sealed interface LocalVariableInfo
LocalVariableInfo is a preview API of the Java platform.
Programs can only use LocalVariableInfo when preview features are enabled.
Preview features may be removed in a future release, or upgraded to permanent features of the Java platform.
Models a single local variable in the LocalVariableTableAttributePREVIEW.
